description: FlowIntel prior to version 4.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows non-approver case members to modify tasks that should be restricted and locked pending approval. This includes operations such as self-unassignment, reordering tasks, linking/unlinking MISP objects and attributes, creating or deleting MISP objects or attributes linked to restricted tasks, and executing modules on these tasks. The flaw bypasses the required approver permission checks, undermining the intended approval workflow.
